import Mathlib
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Dummit_Foote_exercise_1_1_16 {G : Type*} [Group G]
  (x : G) : x ^ 2 = 1 ↔ (orderOf x = 1 ∨ orderOf x = 2) := by
  have h_forward : x ^ 2 = 1 → orderOf x = 1 ∨ orderOf x = 2 := by
    intro h
    have h₁ : orderOf x ∣ 2 := by
      apply orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one
      simpa using h
    have h₂ : orderOf x = 1 ∨ orderOf x = 2 := by
      have h₃ : orderOf x ∣ 2 := h₁
      have h₄ : orderOf x ≤ 2 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide) h₃
      interval_cases orderOf x <;> simp_all (config := {decide := true})
      <;> omega
    exact h₂
  
  have h_backward : orderOf x = 1 ∨ orderOf x = 2 → x ^ 2 = 1 := by
    intro h
    cases h with
    | inl h =>
      have h₁ : x = 1 := by
        have h₂ : orderOf x = 1 := h
        have h₃ : x ^ orderOf x = 1 := by simp [pow_orderOf_eq_one]
        rw [h₂] at h₃
        simpa using h₃
      rw [h₁]
      simp
    | inr h =>
      have h₁ : x ^ 2 = 1 := by
        have h₂ : orderOf x = 2 := h
        have h₃ : x ^ orderOf x = 1 := by simp [pow_orderOf_eq_one]
        rw [h₂] at h₃
        simpa using h₃
      exact h₁
  
  have h_main : x ^ 2 = 1 ↔ (orderOf x = 1 ∨ orderOf x = 2) := by
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      exact h_forward h
    · 
      intro h
      exact h_backward h
  
  apply h_main
